# U109: Dates are picked: as Tunde on the measure step, Baseline and Target each sit beside a week, From “Week 45 · 2–8 Nov 2026 · This week” and To “Week 53 · 28 Dec 2026–3 Jan 2027 · The end of 2026”; opening To lists the three named weeks, then 2026 from week 46, and 2027; typing “14 Dec” chooses week 51; “The end of Q1 2027” closes as “Week 13 · 29 Mar–4 Apr 2027” and the line says it carries into 2027; the keyboard alone moves From to week 40, which asks whether it has been running since, and “No, start from this week” puts it back. Check reads “from 42 min in week 45 (2–8 Nov 2026) to 30 min by week 13 of 2027 (29 Mar–4 Apr 2027)”, and so does the published goal’s About. A stage’s Due is the same picker; no number field for a week is on the step

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `GOAL-DATES`
- **Budget:** at most 30 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Tunde, at `/goals/new` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U109

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Tunde (`tunde`).
- Go to `/goals/new` in the demo.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/what”.
- **Check:** (`progress`) a progress indicator (a ring, steps, dots, a checklist or a bar) is visible.
- **Step.** Type “Signed build queue wait” into the “Name it the way” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Next(: / $)” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/who”.
- **Step.** Press the “Next(: / $)” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/measure”.
- _Note:_ The two rows: Baseline with From, Target with To, each week said with its dates and what it is.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “From Week” button is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- _Note:_ What the week is sits under the picker, or beside its label on a phone.
- **Check:** (`entry`) met when `(await said(from)) === 'Week 45 · 2–8 Nov 2026 · This week' && (await said(to)) === 'Week 53 · 28 Dec 2026–3 Jan 2027 · The end of 2026'`, where `const from = p.getByRole('button', { name: /^From Week/ })`; `const to = p.getByRole('button', { name: /^To Week/ })`; `const said = async (b) => ((await b.innerText()) + ' · ' + (await p.locator('.weekpick', { has: b }).locator('.weekpick-is, .weekpick-is-inline').filter({ visible: true }).first().innerText()).replace(/^\s*·\s*/, '')).trim()`. Else it says: From and To read “{said(from)}” and “{said(to)}”.
- **Check:** (`a11y`) the input in the focus body (`.focus-body input[inputmode="numeric"]`) is not there and the “week” field is not there (else: a week is still a number field on the measure step).
- **Step.** Type “min” into the “Unit” field.
- **Step.** Type “42” into the “Baseline” field.
- **Step.** Type “30” into the “Target” field.
- _Note:_ Opening To: three named weeks, then the years and their weeks.
- **Step.** Press the “To Week” button.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `named === 'The end of 2026 | The end of Q1 2027 | The end of 2027' && years === '2026 2027' && /^Week 46 · 9–15 Nov/.test(firstRow)`, where `const panel = p.locator('.weekpick.open')`; `const named = (await panel.locator('.weekpick-named .strong').allInnerTexts()).join(' | ')`; `const years = (await panel.getByRole('group', { name: 'Year' }).getByRole('button').allInnerTexts()).join(' ')`; `const firstRow = (await panel.getByRole('option').first().innerText()).trim()`. Else it says: To offers “{named}”, years “{years}”, first “{firstRow}”.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “to open”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ What can't be read says so, and changes nothing.
- Type “next spring” into a field in the open week picker.
- Press the Enter key in a field in the open week picker.
- **Check:** (`errors`) met when `await panel.getByRole('status').filter({ hasText: '“next spring” isn’t a week' }).isVisible() && /^Week 53 /.test(await to.innerText())`, where `const to = p.getByRole('button', { name: /^To Week/ })`; `const panel = p.locator('.weekpick.open')`. Else it says: typing what isn’t a week isn’t explained.
- Type “14 Dec” into a field in the open week picker.
- Press the Enter key in a field in the open week picker.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `/^Week 51 · 14–20 Dec 2026/.test(await to.innerText())`, where `const to = p.getByRole('button', { name: /^To Week/ })`. Else it says: “14 Dec” chose {to.innerText()}.
- **Step.** Press the “To Week” button.
- **Step.** Press the “The end of Q1 2027” button in the open week picker.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `(await to.innerText()).trim() === 'Week 13 · 29 Mar–4 Apr 2027'`, where `const to = p.getByRole('button', { name: /^To Week/ })`. Else it says: the end of Q1 2027 reads {to.innerText()}.
- **Check:** “It runs past the end of 2026 and carries into 2027 with this plan.” is shown (else: the line under the numbers doesn’t say it carries into 2027).
- _Note:_ The keyboard alone: open From, down into the list, up five weeks, Enter.
- Move the focus to the “From Week” button.
- Press the Enter key.
- **Check:** A field in the open week picker shows.
- Awaits a wait, and says which one it was if it times out (`waitNamed('focus reaches the week box after Enter', p.waitForFunction(() => document.activeElement?.matches('.weekpick.open input')))`).
- Press the ArrowDown key.
- Awaits a wait, and says which one it was if it times out (`waitNamed('ArrowDown moves focus into the week list', p.waitForFunction(() => document.activeElement?.matches('.weekpick.open [role="listbox"]')))`).
- Repeated, as the code loops:
  - Press the ArrowUp key.
- Awaits a wait, and says which one it was if it times out (`waitNamed('five ArrowUps reach week 40', p.waitForFunction(() => document.activeElement?.getAttribute('aria-activedescendant')?.endsWith('w40')))`).
- Press the Enter key.
- **Check:** The open week picker goes away.
- **Check:** (`a11y`) met when `/^Week 40 · 28 Sep–4 Oct 2026/.test(await from.innerText())`, where `const from = p.getByRole('button', { name: /^From Week/ })`. Else it says: the keyboard chose {from.innerText()}.
- _Note:_ It sits right under From, where the week was just chosen.
- **Check:** (`attention`) the words “Week 40 was 5 weeks ago. Has this been running since then” is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Step.** Press the “No, start from this week” button in a Check question about a number showing “Week 40 was 5 weeks ago. Has this been running since then?”.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `/^Week 45 · 2–8 Nov 2026/.test(await from.innerText())`, where `const from = p.getByRole('button', { name: /^From Week/ })`. Else it says: “No, start from this week” didn’t put From back.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “measure”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Next(: / $)” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/check”.
- **Check:** “from 42 min in week 45 (2–8 Nov 2026) to 30 min by week 13 of 2027 (29 Mar–4 Apr 2027)” is shown (else: Check doesn’t read the weeks back with their dates).
- **Step.** Press the “Publish goal” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/…?published=1”.
- **Check:** “From 42 min in week 45 (2–8 Nov 2026) to 30 min by week 13 of 2027” is shown (else: the goal’s About doesn’t say the same weeks).
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `!!made && (made.plan.fromWeek ?? 0) === NOW && made.plan.endWeek === WEEKS + 13`, where `const snap = await h.snapshot()`; `const made = snap.goals.find((g) => g.title === 'Signed build queue wait')`; `NOW` is 45; `WEEKS` is 53. Else it says: saved From {made && made.plan.fromWeek} and To {made && made.plan.endWeek}.
- _Note:_ A stage's Due is the same picker.
- Go to `/goals/new` in the demo.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/what”.
- **Step.** Type “Signing rolled out in stages” into the “Name it the way” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Hit dated stages” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Next(: / $)” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/who”.
- **Step.** Press the “Next(: / $)” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/measure”.
- **Step.** Type “Pilot” into the “Stage 1” field.
- Open the “Stage 1: due” week picker, type “50” and press Enter.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `/Week 50 · 7–13 Dec 2026/.test(await p.getByRole('button', { name: /^Stage 1: due/ }).innerText())`. Else it says: a stage’s Due isn’t the week picker.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “stage”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- Close this browser.
